diagnostics.message: Geometry integrity detected inconsistent face winding / normals (11 flipped edge-adjacencies of 34083)

warnings: large flat faces split by noisy diagonal topology (random_triangulation_penalty=0.329)
hero asset lacks meaningful high-poly/low-poly distinction (highlow_fake_detail_penalty=0.500)
recommendations: Add controlled panel lines, bevels, or simplified topology on large flat faces. Avoid arbitrary diagonal triangulation.
Add a real high-poly source (bevels, embossed detail, chamfered edges) and bake to the runtime low-poly's normal/AO/curvature maps. If hero mode is intended, opt into the Phase 7 high-poly producer.
Seat attachments (handles, hinges, latches, panels) into sockets, brackets, mount plates, or recessed insets rather than placing them as separate primitives on top of the body.

recommendations: Add a lid seam: the industrial crate grammar requires a visible lid break wrapping the top of the body.
Add corner guards: the industrial crate grammar requires reinforcement corners on the eight body corners.
Add a latch or latch plate at the lid/body seam so the crate has a clear front face.
Seat handles into recessed wells or bracket plates rather than placing them as floating primitives on the shell.
Add horizontal or vertical trim bands to break up the body shell with medium-scale construction hierarchy.
Add visible fasteners (bolts, rivets, or screws) at structural junctions to reinforce the industrial brief.
Add warning text, stencils, or decal zones to provide surface storytelling on the body.
Add edge wear masks so paint chips and metal show at high-traffic edges instead of a uniform debug-material look.
